data.title: Nene Royal wins America’s Got Talent 2026 crown in historic victory
data.description: Phuket teenager Nene Royal makes history as she wins America’s Got Talent Season 21 after a powerful final performance.

data.title: Pakistan strikes ‘terrorist sanctuaries’ in Afghanistan
data.description: An overnight airstrike hit the southern Afghan city of Kandahar, home to the Taliban government’s supreme leader, a resident told AFP early Thursday.

data.title: Catholic baptisms rise among French youth
data.description: MAUREPAS, France - Feeling a little nervous, 21-year-old Thao Bounlay raps three times on the glass door of a church near Paris, declaring to the parish his decision to be baptised.

data.title: North Korea to keep nuclear weapons 'forever': foreign minister
data.description: SEOUL - North Korea will keep its nuclear weapons "forever", its foreign minister vowed Thursday, dismissing the South Korean president's renewed calls for a denuclearised Korean Peninsula.

data.title: Thousands still missing a month after Nepal floods
data.description: KATHMANDU - The tsunami-like flood that cut a swathe of destruction through Nepal on August 26 has left the Himalayan nation grappling with heavy losses and mounting reconstruction needs.

data.title: Nene Royal wins the America's Got Talent 2026
data.description: Nene Royal , the 16-year-old Thai rocker from Phuket, has been crowned the winner of America's Got Talent (AGT) 2026 , after setting the stage alight with ‘ Seven Nation Army ’ in the final round.

data.title: Thai students exempt from new Australian visa measures
data.description: Australian authorities have reaffirmed that Thai students will be exempt from new visa measures affecting international students, while seeking closer cooperation with Thailand on trade, migration and regional security.

data.title: Spain showdown a chance for England to heal World Cup ‘scar’
data.description: LONDON - The visit to Wembley by world champions Spain on Saturday will be a painful reminder to England of what might have been, but Thomas Tuchel needs a positive response to silence criticism of how the Three Lions’ World Cup ended.

data.title: ONE Championship: Superlek’s ‘let go’ post raises questions over kickboxing title
data.description: Superlek Kiatmoo9 has raised questions over the future of his ONE Championship flyweight kickboxing title with a cryptic social media message as he faces a lengthy recovery from knee surgery.

data.title: Nene Royal joins Linkin Park on AGT stage ahead of final result
data.description: Thai rocker Nene Royal performs “The Emptiness Machine” with Linkin Park on the America’s Got Talent 2026 stage ahead of the season 21 result.

data.title: 8 suicide attempts confirmed on US aircraft carrier
data.description: WASHINGTON - The Trump administration has acknowledged eight suicide attempts by US service members during the extended deployment of an aircraft carrier to the Middle East, a US lawmaker revealed on Wednesday.

data.title: TrueOnline Home Next wins BUSINESS+ Product of the Year Awards 2026
data.description: His Excellency H.E. Nurak Marpraneet, Privy Councillor graced the awards ceremony as the presiding guest. Representing the ceremony, with Mr. Tanaphon Manavutiveth, Chief Home Connectivity Officer, True Corporation Plc, attended to receive the award. The selection process was rigorous, including quantitative surveys from consumers nationwide and qualitative evaluations by a panel of experts.

data.title: Colombians in Santa Marta stay inside after violence wracks the city
data.description: SANTA MARTA (COLOMBIA) - Stores and schools closed and drivers mostly stayed off the roads Wednesday as the Colombian city of Santa Marta limped back to normal after a wave of drug-gang violence prompted a deployment of army troops.

data.title: Australian PM says OpenAI hacked government health website
data.description: SYDNEY - An autonomous OpenAI program infiltrated an Australian government health website in June in an "unacceptable" breach, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said.

data.title: North Korean IT contractor found remote work in New Zealand: agency
data.description: WELLINGTON - A North Korean IT worker used a fake identity to obtain remote work with a New Zealand company and then threatened to release sensitive information when exposed, Wellington's cybersecurity agency said Thursday.

data.title: Iran airlines cancel flights as US sanctions hit
data.description: TEHRAN - Iranian airlines were forced to cancel some international flights on Wednesday after the United States tightened sanctions on Iran's aviation industry in a new effort to cripple its economy.

data.title: Morocco elects new parliament amid social frustration, youth discontent
data.description: RABAT - Moroccans worried about unemployment and inequality cast their ballots for a new parliament on Wednesday, in the country's first poll since a mass migration crisis and a youth-led protest movement highlighted widespread discontentment among young people.

data.title: 'What Remains' runs until Sunday at Central Embassy
data.description: Art lovers have until Sunday to discover the echoes of feelings and experiences through "What Remains", which is running on the ground floor of Central Embassy, Phloenchit Road.

data.title: Manga madness at The Mall Bangkae
data.description: Enter the immersive world of Japanese culture during "The Mall Lifestore Manga Multiverse", at M Grand Hall and M Fashion Hall 1, ground floor of The Mall Lifestore Bangkae, Phetkasem Road, from today until next Wednesday.

data.title: Campaign to support political prisoners opens submissions for typographic poster art
data.description: The Weight Of Sentences civic campaign organised by 112Watch and the Thai Lawyers for Human Rights has opened submissions for typographic poster art to support political prisoners or those living in exile.

data.title: DSI head appointment raises PP ire
data.description: The opposition has raised concerns over the appointment of Pol Capt Piya Raksakul as the new director-general of the Department of Special Investigation (DSI), warning the agency could be turned into a political tool or used to benefit people facing criminal charges.

data.title: Traffy Fondue to expand its reach across govt agencies
data.description: The Traffy Fondue platform has been adopted as a central government service for reporting and managing urban problems, the Minister of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation, Yodchanan Wongsawat, said.

data.title: PP 'has no shield' for probe MPs
data.description: The People's Party (PP) will not shield MPs Pawoot Pongvitayapanu or Somchart Techathavorncharoen with parliamentary immunity if evidence links them to wrongdoing, said the party leader.

data.title: House passes bill to protect debtors
data.description: The House of Representatives has passed a bill amending the Bankruptcy Act to protect honest debtors undergoing court-approved debt rehabilitation.

data.title: Sondhi asks public to turn out for EC complaint
data.description: Protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul and allies are urging the public to join them in filing a complaint with the Election Commission (EC) tomorrow over Senate election collusion.
